sources.name: ARES – Registr ekonomických subjektů (open REST API)
sources.category: national commercial register / master company registry
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Genuinely open JSON REST API, no key required (Swagger UI live at https://ares.gov.cz/swagger-ui/ — JS app, confirmed reachable). The canonical CZ master registry aggregating OR, RES, tax and trade-licence registers. Backbone source for all CZ entity resolution.

sources.name: Veřejný rejstřík (Obchodní rejstřík) – justice.cz
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Publicly searchable without login (confirmed by fetch). Full extracts + document collection (financial statements, deeds). No API on this UI — machine route is ARES API + dataor bulk dumps.

sources.name: dataor.justice.cz – commercial register open data (bulk XML)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED reachable (page titled 'Opendata'; JS-rendered, content thin via fetch). Known Ministry of Justice bulk XML dumps of the commercial register by court/legal form/year — the free bulk companion to ARES.

sources.name: ČSÚ – Registr ekonomických subjektů (RES) + open data
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. csu.gov.cz confirms both 'Registr ekonomických subjektů' and 'Otevřená data' sections. RES data also flows into ARES; useful for NACE-coded population counts.

sources.name: Evidence skutečných majitelů (UBO register)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED but RESTRICTED: as of 17 Dec 2025 the Ministry of Justice closed public access; only AML-obliged entities, authorities and the registered persons themselves get data (confirmed on-page). Do NOT plan on open UBO data — consistent with project law.

sources.name: ČNB – Lists and registers of supervised financial market entities
sources.category: financial regulator registers (banks, funds, AIFMs, investment firms, insurers, pension companies, CASPs)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Hub page links the JERRS application (all licensed/registered entities incl. investment companies, ZISIF §15 managers, MiCA CASPs), prospectuses, and 'Web services WS JERRS'. This is the single regulator register for the whole LP+GP licensee universe (ČNB supervises banking, funds, insurance AND pensions).

sources.name: ČNB JERRS – search application
sources.verdict: URL is the long-standing official JERRS app but our fetch got ECONNREFUSED (likely geo/WAF filtering of datacenter IPs). Treat UI as gated for automation; use WS JERRS or the CNB lists pages instead. Documented honestly, not re-verified.

sources.name: ČNB WS JERRS – XML web services
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. XML/SOAP services at https://aplc.cnb.cz/jerrsws/ws with WSDL/XSD; entity-by-role list service mirrors the public lists. GATED: requires a commercial certificate (I.CA/Postsignum/eIdentity) + signed application to jerrsws@cnb.cz. Feasible but an onboarding task, not anonymous open data.

sources.name: ČNB ARAD – statistics time-series database
sources.category: central bank statistics (fund sector aggregates, bank balance sheets)
sources.verdict: Exists (JS single-page app; fetch returned only shell). ARAD is the CNB time-series warehouse with CSV export; useful for market-size context on funds, pensions, insurance. Machine route not verified in this pass.

sources.name: ERÚ – energy license holders register
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Searchable license-holder finder plus weekly-updated downloadable lists of license holders (electricity, gas, heat, renewables) — latest 31.07.2026 visible. Strong source for Real Assets/energy-transition SPV discovery.

sources.name: OTE a.s. – electricity/gas market operator & emissions registry administrator
sources.category: carbon / EU ETS national registry + power market data
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. OTE runs the CZ power/gas short-term markets and the 'Environmental certificates' agenda (CZ administrator of the Union Registry emissions accounts). Market statistics public; ETS account holder lists limited — verify depth before relying on it.

sources.name: ISIR – Insolvenční rejstřík
sources.verdict: VERIFIED register with public lustration search and an 'Automatické sledování ins. rejstříku' service; ISIR has a long-standing public SOAP web service for change-feeds (the hint is correct), though the WS help link we tried 404'd — endpoint docs must be re-located. NEW: replacement register eISIR is live in testing at https://eisir.justice.cz (confirmed, 'ověřovací režim', no API docs published yet). Plan for migration.

sources.name: Obchodní věstník (Commercial Bulletin)
sources.category: official gazette (liquidations, capital changes, insolvency notices, AGMs)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Official bulletin published every working day via the Public Administration Portal, operated by Economia. Last 6 months free; archive to 1992 paid. Key signal source for liquidations/conversions.

sources.name: e-Sbírka – official collection of laws
sources.verdict: VERIFIED reachable at gov.cz domain (301 from e-sbirka.cz). Official consolidated law collection — regulatory-change monitoring, not entity data. API availability not verified.

sources.name: Seznam insolvenčních správců (insolvency practitioner roll)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Public MoJ list, 434 administrators, filterable by name/IČO/district, with HQ + branches — direct feed for the Private Debt service-graph (insolvency practitioners).

sources.name: Prague Stock Exchange (PSE / Burza cenných papírů Praha)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Prime/Standard/Free/Start markets, exchange member list, issuer guides, press center. Per-market issuer tables confirmed parseable (e.g. https://www.pse.cz/udaje-o-trhu/akcie/prime-market lists 12 Prime issuers in an HTML table). START market = SME/growth issuer discovery.

sources.name: RM-SYSTÉM, česká burza cenných papírů
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Operating since 1993, listed-security price table on homepage incl. Czech issuers. Secondary but real for issuer coverage.

sources.name: CDCP – Central Securities Depository Prague
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Public participant list, statistics, LEI-provider role, DLT registry docs. No full public ISIN/issuer dump confirmed.

sources.name: CVCA – Czech Private Equity & Venture Capital Association members
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Full + associate member lists (GPs: Genesis, Enterprise Investors, Mid Europa…; advisors: law firms, Big 4, banks). Core GP + service-graph seed. (Task notes CVCA members already ingested.)

sources.name: AKAT ČR – Czech Capital Market Association
sources.category: asset management / fund industry association + statistics
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Member directory ('Členové asociace') + quarterly AuM statistics (CZK 2.33tn in funds). Maps the ManCo/fund-manager universe incl. liquid alts distributors.

sources.name: ČBA – Czech Banking Association
sources.verdict: Reachable; navigation confirmed (ČBA Monitor, news service) but page is JS-heavy and member list not verified in-fetch. Real association; treat scraping route as to-be-confirmed.

sources.name: ČLFA – Czech Leasing and Finance Association
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Member company list + quarterly non-bank financing statistics (corporate financing CZK 8.57bn 2026 figure on homepage). Direct feed for specialty-finance/ABL entity discovery.

sources.name: ČAP – Czech Insurance Association
sources.verdict: Fetch REJECTED by security gateway (supin.cz WAF). The association is real and publishes member lists + market statistics, but automated access is blocked — needs browser-grade crawling or manual snapshot. Documented honestly.

sources.name: APS ČR – Association of Pension Companies
sources.verdict: VERIFIED at apscr.cz (old apfcr.cz DNS times out). Confirms 9 members = all Czech pension companies. Small but complete LP-side roster; pension companies also in ČNB JERRS.

sources.name: NRB – Národní rozvojová banka (National Development Bank)
sources.category: development bank / state LP (incl. NDIF IPO Fund 2025+)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Programs (guarantees, transformation loans) and the National Development Investment Fund's 'IPO Fund 2025+' equity vehicle confirmed on-page — a genuine domestic LP/fund-of-funds actor.

sources.name: CzechInvest – Business & Investment Development Agency
sources.verdict: VERIFIED (301 from czechinvest.org to gov.cz — update stored URLs). FDI news, startup programs (ESA BIC, Technology Incubation). Also now hosts czechstartups.gov.cz (301 from czechstartups.org confirmed) — startup ecosystem portal.

sources.name: EGAP – Export Guarantee and Insurance Corporation
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. State export insurer; annual reports, country Risk Barometer, insured-volume stats. Institutional-graph node and trade-finance signal source.

sources.name: ÚZSVM + nabidkamajetku.gov.cz – state asset administration & sales
sources.category: state property office / asset disposals & auctions
sources.verdict: VERIFIED (301 from uzsvm.cz to gov.cz). Press releases + property marketplace at nabidkamajetku.gov.cz (real estate, movables) — distressed/real-asset deal-flow signal.

sources.name: NEN – Národní elektronický nástroj (public procurement)
sources.verdict: Official national e-procurement tool, but our fetch got ECONNREFUSED (likely WAF vs datacenter IPs). Use VVZ (below) and its open data as the machine route; NEN UI access unverified.

sources.name: VVZ – Věstník veřejných zakázek (procurement bulletin)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED reachable (MMR-operated bulletin; page shell confirmed, content JS-rendered). MMR historically publishes procurement open-data dumps; concessions/PPP notices relevant to infra. Bulk route to be pinned down.

sources.name: Registr smluv (state contract register)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Statutory register (law 340/2015); confirmed 'Aplikační rozhraní ISRS' API section + open-data page. Every public-sector contract >CZK 50k is here — counterparty and infra-deal signal, genuinely open.

sources.name: data.gov.cz – National open data catalog
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Národní katalog otevřených dat — the discovery layer for CZ open datasets (incl. justice, procurement, contract-register dumps). SPARQL/DCAT catalog access.

sources.name: Hlídač státu
sources.category: civic open-data aggregator (contracts, subsidies, companies, insolvency) with API
sources.verdict: API confirmed to exist and be auth-gated: /api returns 401 without a token (free key on registration; swagger path we tried 404'd). Aggregates registr smluv, subsidies, insolvency, political links — useful cross-reference layer, not a primary register.

sources.name: ČAK – Czech Bar Association attorney search
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Public search of attorneys/trainees by name, city, firm, practice area, language. Self-reported specializations (per ČAK disclaimer).

sources.name: KA ČR – Chamber of Auditors auditor register
sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Public 'vyber-auditora' register search of licensed auditors/audit firms — feeds Liquid Alternatives / service-graph auditor nodes.

sources.name: Seznam znalců – register of court experts incl. property valuers
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via znalci.justice.cz which links the public searchable list (experts + expert institutes) at seznat.justice.cz. CZ equivalent of a valuer roll (RICS has no public CZ-specific directory; RICS 'Find a Surveyor' is global — noted in searchedButAbsent).

sources.verdict: VERIFIED. Annual Trend Report archive 2002–2026 + member directory of RE market leaders — Real Assets ecosystem mapping and research source.

sources.verdict: VERIFIED redirect target (301 from czechstartups.org). Now state-run (CzechInvest orbit). Content depth/database structure not verified in this pass.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Thin-but-real CZ coverage: a handful of CZ-domiciled GPs (Genesis Capital, Jet Investment, ARX Equity, Enern etc.), CEE funds in fundraising, and CZ institutions as LPs. Weak below the top PE tier; near-zero on CZ niche alts and the service graph.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: CNB regulated-entity lists (fund manager licensing), CVCA membership and yearbook, fund annual reports filed to the commercial register (sbírka listin at or.justice.cz), press releases — all of which we can hit directly via ARES/dataor + CVCA + ČNB lists.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Better CZ deal coverage than Preqin on buyouts and growth (tracks Jet, Genesis, BHM, Sev.en, PPF, EC Investments deal activity); valuations largely modeled. Service-provider tagging (law firms, advisors) is decent but built from deal press.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Deal press (HN, E15, CzechCrunch, CTK wire), commercial register filings for confirmations, PSE disclosures, CVCA. All directly accessible to us: the same RSS feeds plus ARES/OR filings.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Strongest global platform for the CZ startup/VC layer; works with local ecosystem partners and powers regional startup reports. Good founder/round data, weak on PE, debt, real assets.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: czechstartups.gov.cz ecosystem data, CzechCrunch and Lupa coverage, ARES for firmographics, accelerator/VC portfolio pages. We can go straight to ARES + cc.cz/feed + CzechInvest programs.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Broad but shallow CZ startup coverage; funding rounds crowd-sourced + press-scraped; entity hygiene noticeably worse than Dealroom for CEE.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Startup press (CzechCrunch, Forbes.cz), company self-submissions, ARES-derived registry data via aggregators. Direct route for us: same press RSS + ARES canonical records.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: LOCAL. The dominant CZ firmographic/credit-data provider: full company universe, financials from filed statements, payment/insolvency flags, ownership links. This is what CZ banks and NPL buyers actually use for counterparty data.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: ARES + obchodní rejstřík bulk data (dataor XML), sbírka listin financial statements, ISIR insolvency feed, Obchodní věstník, VVZ/registr smluv. Every underlying source is public and in our catalog — Cribis' moat is parsing scale, not exclusive access.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: LOCAL/global hybrid. Firmographics, scoring, ownership trees (incl. cross-border via D&B WorldBase). Used for KYC/AML and supplier risk; no alternatives-specific intelligence.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Same public spine: ARES, OR + sbírka listin, ISIR, Obchodní věstník, plus proprietary trade-payment data (not public — we don't need it for entity mapping).

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: LOCAL sales-intelligence layer over the CZ registry universe: firmographics, contacts, technographic/web signals, insolvency and turnover estimates. B2B-sales oriented, not investment-grade.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: ARES API, dataor dumps, ISIR, registr smluv, VVZ, company websites. All public and cataloged above.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: LOCAL Czech firmographic/predictive-signals provider (growth scoring, tech detection) used by banks/telcos for prospecting. No alternatives focus but demonstrates what is derivable from CZ open registries.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: ARES/RES, commercial register filings, procurement + contract-register open data, web crawling. Direct-source equivalents fully covered in our catalog.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: LOCAL civic-tech aggregator, free/open with API: contracts, subsidies, insolvency, sponsor/political links across CZ entities. Not a competitor commercially but the best proof-of-concept of CZ open-data fusion; useful as a cross-check layer.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Registr smluv API, VVZ open data, ISIR, ARES, subsidy registers (DotInfo/CEDR) — all public; its own API is free-key gated (401 without token).

searchedButAbsent: Web SEARCH budget was exhausted at session start (200/200 used by the parent workflow), so all verification was done by direct URL fetching; local-language search-based discovery of long-tail sources was therefore narrower than intended. Searched/attempted but NOT confirmed: (1) a dedicated ČNB MiCA/CASP licensee page — the guessed URL 404'd; CASPs are licensed by ČNB and should appear in the JERRS lists, but the specific list route needs confirmation; (2) a standalone fund-administrator/depositary licensee list — exists only as roles inside ČNB JERRS, no separate public roll found; (3) RICS Czech Republic member directory — RICS has no public CZ-specific directory URL verified; only the global rics.org 'Find a Surveyor'; the Czech court-expert register (seznat.justice.cz) is the practical valuer roll; (4) ISIR web-service documentation — the WS help link 404'd and the new eISIR (eisir.justice.cz, in testing mode) publishes no API docs yet, so the exact SOAP endpoint must be re-located even though the service is known to exist; (5) Asociace developerů ČR — asociacedeveloperu.cz DNS did not resolve from this environment; (6) iRozhlas economy RSS — guessed feed URL 404'd; (7) Stavební fórum (stavebni-forum.cz) — connection refused; (8) ČAP insurance association — hard WAF block (supin.cz gateway); (9) kurzy.cz RSS index and Hlídač státu swagger — pages exist but yielded no concrete endpoints; (10) CNB ARAD and dataor.justice.cz are JS-shell pages whose bulk/export routes could not be inspected by fetch. NEN (nen.nipez.cz) and apl.cnb.cz JERRS UI refused connections — likely datacenter-IP filtering, so production crawler IPs should retest. Also deliberately absent: open UBO data (esm.justice.cz closed to the public on 2025-12-17 — confirmed on-site), and any Preqin/PitchBook/Dealroom/Crunchbase scraping (prohibited by project law; market-map analysis only).
